metadata.summary: A large dataset of 377,110 chest x-rays associated with 227,827 imaging studies sourced from the Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center between 2011 and 2016. Images are provided with 14 labels derived from two natural language processing tools applied to the corresponding free-text radiology reports. Derived entirely from the MIMIC-CXR database; all images de-identified.
metadata.purpose: To provide a convenient processed version of MIMIC-CXR and a standard reference for data splits and image labels, facilitating research in medical computer vision.

papers.title: MIMIC-CXR-JPG, a large publicly available database of labeled chest radiographs

ethics.privacy_measures: All images have been de-identified to protect patient privacy.
ethics.legal_compliance: Complies with PhysioNet data use requirements; IRB-approved at BIDMC.

extraction.notes: Baseline card derived solely from dataset_catalog.xlsx real metadata; remaining fields require paper/README or manual completion.

known_limitations: Labels derived from NLP of free-text reports introduce label noise.
Single-center origin limits geographic and practice diversity.
No demographic subgroup statistics reported (e.g., age, sex, ethnicity).
De-identification may remove clinically relevant metadata.
bias_and_limitations.modifications: Yes — conversion from DICOM to JPG and NLP-derived labeling; derived from MIMIC-CXR.
bias_and_limitations.representativeness_concerns: Single-center (BIDMC, Boston, USA); no evidence of diverse demographic or international representation.
bias_and_limitations.generalizability_statement: Generalizability limited by single-center, US-based, 2011–2016 cohort; no explicit assessment of temporal or device-related shifts.
bias_and_limitations.missing_data: Demographic attributes (age, sex, ethnicity) not reported in source text.

data_origin.selection_rationale: Derived entirely from the MIMIC-CXR database; aims to provide a convenient processed version and standard reference.
data_origin.data_shifts_overtime: Data collected 2011–2016; no explicit statement of longitudinal shifts or multi-version comparisons in source text.

population.target_population: Adult patients undergoing chest radiography at Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center

annotation.annotation_method: 14 labels derived via NLP from free-text radiology reports using two natural language processing tools
annotation.labeling_provenance: Labels extracted from free-text radiology reports via NLP; no manual verification stated in abstract.
annotation.label_noise_description: Labels derived from NLP of free-text reports; known to contain noise due to imperfect extraction.
